_doc: AC08 (Контейнер НКУ) VPM texture sets, KPP1 recipe (jobs/KPP1/scripts/vpm_textures.json). Gate 1 approved by Artem 2026-10-22 (#565 comment: «Принимаю»): ID2 sandwich panels RAL 5015, ID3 door RAL 7004, mixed ID1 = roof RAL 7004 + frame RAL 7004 + perimeter drop below ±0.000 in the wall colour. Panels per Artem 2026-10-22 on the v006 render: «должны быть вертикальные швы только; текстуру пришлю; если не влезает, то можно аккуратно порезать через loop или ring»: ID2 = PanelVJ_RAL5015 = Artem's texture panel_RAL5015_vertical_joints_4096.png (4096 px, joints 8 mm every 600 px, panel median = KPP 5015 RGB exactly), at the KPP VPM texel 1000 px/m (density twin KPP Cassette_RAL5015, S = 4.096 m), vertical joints every 0.60 m from each panel's edge with the smaller world coordinate (the mirrored long facades share one grid); faces longer than the tile holds (S - 2 pad - P = 3.416 m) are cut by edge rings at joint positions (finish_map.apply_cuts, every cut listed in the build report). The drop below ±0.000 stays plain KPP 5015 without joints. RGB = exact KPP tiles (maps_kpp T_Kpp_1_Diffuse_1.1013 = RAL 5015, .1010 = RAL 7004, pixel-verified in jobs/TEC26-OKS/AC08/MATERIALS.md); roughness/metallic = the KPP proposals of the same finishes. Placeholders: 256 px single colour (reg p.31 §3, density-exempt reg p.31-32 §6.1). Address Nku_1 is a placeholder token (address/coordinates deferred as for KPP).
